Founder Decision AgendaLink

SequenceFounder QuestionRequired ReadingDecision Output
First passIs the issue contained or only actively managed?Review complaint brief, CAPA module, CAPA governance board, and traceability room.Keep investigation open unless root-cause and containment proof are current.
Second passCan customer remedy be finalized without uncontrolled margin leakage?Review recovery module, claims recovery board, account room, and profitability board.Finalize remedy only with exposure, supplier offset, and margin consequence visible.
Third passIs supplier accountability strong enough?Review supplier approval, supplier performance board, traceability, and shipment review.Keep Golden Harvest approved with controls and update scoring if prevention proof is weak.
Fourth passCan the case close or stay in controlled review?Review control integrity, matter control, CAPA verification, claims recovery, and proof routes together.Keep closure blocked until customer, supplier, compliance, and finance layers carry one answer.
